mapper.select: SELECT f.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM test_case tc WHERE tc.folder_id = f.id) AS test_case_count FROM test_case_folder f WHERE f.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY f.sort_order, f.id
mapper.update: UPDATE test_case_folder SET name = #{name} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE test_case_folder SET parent_folder_id = #{targetParentId} WHERE parent_folder_id = #{folderId}
UPDATE test_case SET folder_id = #{targetParentId} WHERE folder_id = #{folderId}
